sn15.20:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || 2
sn15.20:2.2: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānam sattānam taṇhāsamyojanānaṃ sandhāvatam saṃsarataṃ || || 4
sn15.20:2.3: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave imassa Vepulassa pabbatassa Pācīnavaṃso tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:2.4: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ Tivarā tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:2.5: Tivarānam bhikkhave manussānam cattārisaṃ vassasahassāni āyuppamāṇam ahosi || ||
sn15.20:2.6: Tivarā bhikkhave manussā Pācīnavaṃsaṃ pabbataṃ catuhena ārohanti catuhena orohanti || || 5
sn15.20:2.7: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti || ||
sn15.20:2.8: Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Vidhura-Sajīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugam ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ || || 6
sn15.20:2.9: Passatha bhikkhave sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā || te ca manussā kālaṃkatā || so ca Bhagavā parinibbuto || || 7
sn15.20:2.13: yāvaṃ cidaṃ bhikkhave alam eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccituṃ || || 8
sn15.20:3.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imassa Vepulassa pabbatassa Vaṅkako tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:3.2: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ Rohitassā tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:3.3: Rohitassānam bhikkhave manussānam tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇam ahosi || ||
sn15.20:3.4: Rohitassā bhikkhave manussā Vaṅkakam pabbatam tīhena arohanti tīhena orohanti || || 9
sn15.20:3.5: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Koṇāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti || ||
sn15.20:3.6: Koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Bhiyyo-Suttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugam ahosi aggam bhaddayugaṃ || || 10
sn15.20:3.7: Passatha bhikkhave || sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā te ca manussā kālaṃkatā so ca Bhagavā parinibbuto ||
sn15.20:4.1: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave imassa Vepullassa pabbatassa Supasso tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:4.2: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ Suppiyā tveva samaññā udapādi ||
sn15.20:4.3: Suppiyānam bhikkhave manussānaṃ vīsati vassasahassani āyuppamāṇam ahosi || ||
sn15.20:4.4: Suppiyā bhikkhave manussā Supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti dvīhena orohanti || || 12
sn15.20:4.5: Tena kho pana samayena Kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti ||
sn15.20:4.6: Kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa TissaBhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugam ahosi aggam bhaddayugaṃ || || 13
sn15.20:4.7: Passatha bhikkhave || Sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā te ca manussā kālaṃkatā so ca Bhagavā parinibbuto || || 14
sn15.20:5.1: Etarahi kho pana bhikkhave imassa Vepullassa pabbatassa Vepullo tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:5.2: Etarahi kho pana bhikkhave imesam manussānaṃ Māgadhakā tveva samaññā udapādi || ||
sn15.20:5.3: Māgadhakānam bhikkhave manussānam appakam āyuppamāṇam parittaṃ lahukaṃ ||
sn15.20:5.4: yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasatam appaṃ vā bhiyyo || ||
sn15.20:5.5: Māgadhakā bhikkhave manussā Vepullam pabbatam muhuttena ārohanti muhuttena orohanti || || 16
sn15.20:5.6: Etarahi kho panāham bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno ||
sn15.20:5.7: mayham kho pana bhikkhave Sāriputta-Moggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugam aggam bhaddayugaṃ || || 17
sn15.20:5.8: Bhavissati bhikkhave so samayo || yā ayañ cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antaradhāyissati || ime ca manussā kālaṃ karissanti ahañ ca parinibbāyissāmi || || 18
sn15.20:5.12: Yāvaṃ cidaṃ bhikkhave alam eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitun ti || || 19
sn15.20:6.2: idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
